label_notes.documented: stated by the dataset authors / paper (night id, elevations and lunar fraction are computed and published by the authors, not instrument readings; source_dataquality copied from *_dataquality.csv; place and paper_label from the paper; unit from the paper Methods)
label_notes.inferred: derived by this script from the source by the rules in spectra_meta.json (counts, date ranges, cell counts, selected source columns, SHA-256 of the source file)
label_notes.measured: spectrometer readings (irradiance) and their recorded timestamps, copied as source text
